title: Argentinian Mung Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with mung beans and a variety of vegetables, inspired by the flavors of Argentina.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the mung beans, roast, sprouts, and bean sprouts. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the mung beans are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
